title: Aina za Nomino (Theme 3: Mapambo)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names an idea, feeling or quality that cannot be touched (upendo, furaha, uzuri) and forms it from an adjective or verb.
representations: two columns: can touch / cannot touch
steps: If not, it may be abstract.
Form it with u- or from the verb.

board.say: Jina la tabia hii ni lipi?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "ukarimu" and a sentence with it.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Nomino ya dhahania ni ipi?" Kwa nini "kitabu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kitabu kinaweza kushikwa kwa mkono. Nomino ya dhahania haishikiki: ni wazo au hisia, kama upendo.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mama ana moyo wa ___." Kwa nini "kupenda" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kupenda ni kitenzi. Nomino ya dhahania inayotokana nacho ni upendo.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Bibi yetu ana ___ mwingi." Kwa nini "mkarimu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Mkarimu ni mtu mwenye tabia hiyo. Nomino ya dhahania ni ukarimu, yaani tabia yenyewe.

misconceptions.ask: Neno hili ni jina la wazo au linaeleza mtu?
misconceptions.repair: Kutoka kivumishi: mzuri -> uzuri (nomino ya dhahania).

checks.question: Ni nomino ya dhahania ipi: meza, upendo, mti?
